# Techyuga Labs

> Techyuga Labs is an independent software practice founded by Akshay C K. Each app is designed with intent, considered end-to-end, and shipped only when it is actually ready. The first live app is Readyuga, an offline AI ebook reader for Android.

Techyuga Labs ships software that respects the person using it: no account requirements, no ads, no subscriptions when a one-time purchase will do, no cloud when the work can run on-device. The studio publishes long-form guides on reading tools, privacy, on-device AI, and the mechanics of attention — all research-tested and signed by a named author.

## Apps

- [Readyuga](https://techyugalabs.com/apps/pagesage/): The offline AI ebook reader. Reads PDFs and EPUBs with an on-device AI companion (chapter summaries, page Q&A, contextual meanings) and neural voices (Lessac, Amy, Ryan). No account, no cloud, no subscription. Android only. Single one-time Pro unlock for all premium features.

## Guides

- [Book Reading Apps: 7 Options Tested in 2026](https://techyugalabs.com/guides/book-reading-apps/): A practical, tested comparison of ReadEra, Readyuga, Moon+ Reader, Librera Pro, FullReader, Kotobee Reader, and @Voice Aloud Reader. Includes honest disclosure that Techyuga Labs builds Readyuga, with scenario-matched recommendations so each reader finds the right tool for their use case.
